verdict.rationale: Mastra natively persists execution state to storage, so suspended agents and workflows can pause indefinitely and resume from a snapshot exactly where they left off. It also documents durable thread-scoped goals for long-lived agents. However, no evidence explicitly covers automatic recovery of in-flight runs after a crash, process restart or redeploy, and no durable-execution engine integration is evidenced. missing for 10: explicit crash/restart/deploy recovery of running agents, durable-execution integrations (e.g. external workflow engines), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run long-lived agents durably across process restarts and deploys, natively or via durable-execution integrations

citations.quote: Mastra uses storage to remember execution state, so you can pause indefinitely and resume where you left off.
Snapshots capture all the information needed to resume a workflow from exactly where it left off
A goal is a durable, thread-scoped objective: a standing instruction the agent keeps working toward across loop iterations
Events flow through PubSub, which means a client can disconnect and reconnect without missing chunks.
